title: The Last Machine Anew
author: Lena Whitlock
blurb: Juniper Blackwood, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
